describes: packages/core/signature: validateChain over pkijs's chain engine.

cases.name: trust-no-port
cases.covers: No trust port is `unknown`: nothing was checked.

cases.name: trust-no-anchors
cases.covers: A port with no anchors is `unknown` too.

cases.name: trust-anchors-reject
cases.covers: A port whose anchors() rejects rejects the validation.

cases.name: trust-bad-anchor
cases.covers: An anchor that is not a certificate rejects the validation.

$error.name: AsnError
$error.message: Error during parsing of ASN.1 data. Data is not correct for 'Certificate'.

cases.name: trust-unparseable-cms
cases.covers: A CMS that does not parse is `untrusted` with the parser's message.

resolved.reason: CMS has 2 signers; exactly one is expected

cases.name: trust-root
cases.covers: The chain engine starts from the LAST certificate the CMS carries (the intermediate here) and reaches the root.

cases.name: trust-root-with-root-carried
cases.covers: A carried copy of the anchor is dropped before the path is built.

cases.name: trust-intermediate-last
cases.covers: Carried order decides the start: [leaf, root, inter] starts from the intermediate.

cases.name: trust-expired-leaf-not-checked
cases.covers: An expired signer followed by a valid intermediate is trusted: the signer is never on the path.

cases.name: trust-leaf-only-root
cases.covers: A lone signer whose issuer is neither carried nor trusted has no path.

cases.name: trust-leaf-only-intermediate
cases.covers: A lone signer trusted through its issuer.

cases.name: trust-intermediate-anchor-carried
cases.covers: A carried certificate that is itself an anchor is a path of two copies.

cases.name: trust-self-signed-anchor
cases.covers: A self-signed signer trusted directly.

cases.name: trust-self-signed-other
cases.covers: A self-signed signer with an unrelated anchor.

cases.name: trust-other-root
cases.covers: An unrelated root is no path.

cases.name: trust-by-issuer-name
cases.covers: A signer without an authority key identifier finds its issuer by name.

cases.name: trust-expired-intermediate
cases.covers: An expired certificate on the path.

resolved.reason: The certificate is either not yet valid or expired

cases.name: trust-expired-signer
cases.covers: An expired lone signer.

resolved.reason: The certificate is either not yet valid or expired

cases.name: trust-not-yet-valid
cases.covers: A validation time before every certificate's notBefore.

resolved.reason: The certificate is either not yet valid or expired

cases.name: trust-at-timestamp
cases.covers: A validation time inside the validity window.

cases.name: trust-at-now
cases.covers: An explicit `now` is the clock.

cases.name: trust-ca-without-basic-constraints
cases.covers: An issuer with keyCertSign but no BasicConstraints.

resolved.reason: One of intermediate certificates is not a CA certificate

cases.name: trust-ca-without-cert-sign
cases.covers: A CA whose key usage lacks keyCertSign.

resolved.reason: One of intermediate certificates is not a CA certificate

cases.name: trust-ca-unknown-critical
cases.covers: A CA with a critical extension pkijs cannot parse.

cases.name: trust-issuer-not-ca
cases.covers: An issuer that says it is not a CA.

resolved.reason: One of intermediate certificates is not a CA certificate

cases.name: trust-wrong-issuer-name
cases.covers: Found by key identifier, refused by name chaining.

cases.name: trust-pss-certificate
cases.covers: A certificate signed with RSASSA-PSS (SHA-384) verifies against its issuer.

cases.name: trust-ec-leaf
cases.covers: An EC signer issued by an RSA intermediate.

cases.name: trust-ec-self-signed
cases.covers: An EC self-signed signer with an unrelated anchor: its own ECDSA signature is checked first.

cases.name: trust-ec-self-signed-anchor
cases.covers: An EC self-signed signer trusted directly.
